core_question: Can TSMC continue converting the structural AI/HPC capital-spending cycle into leading-edge and advanced-packaging revenue, high utilization, durable operating margins and free cash flow fast enough to outrun elevated expectations while avoiding material technology, customer, overseas-cost or geopolitical impairment?
dominant_variable: Durability and capital productivity of AI/HPC-driven leading-edge and advanced-packaging capacity expansion relative to already-high market expectations.

epistemic_audit.note: Earliest recovered user-side explicit TSM research record is 2025-08-19. No verified contemporaneous buy/add/trim/stop/target record was recovered; connected IBKR returned no trades in the checked 2025 Q3/Q4 windows.

decision_state.action_logic: The $395-$420 zone and >=12% drawdown are re-underwrite triggers, not automatic trade signals. Require joint alignment of price, evidence, expectations and portfolio risk.
start_small_conditions: FY2026/FY2027 EPS and company guidance have not deteriorated materially.
Upstream AI compute demand remains supportive.
Initial position remains a small research sleeve rather than a full-size conviction position.
add_conditions: Fundamental upgrade: revenue/EPS guidance or upstream AI capex evidence rises enough to improve expected return despite a higher price.
Price reset: valuation compresses materially while AI/HPC demand, technology execution, margin framework and geopolitical operating conditions remain intact.
trim_conditions: Price/multiple expands materially faster than earnings estimates.
Expected return compresses without corresponding new fundamental evidence.
kill_criteria: AI/HPC demand deteriorates for multiple quarters and major customers materially reduce real infrastructure plans.
N2/A16/advanced-packaging execution or yield leadership suffers a structural failure or major leading-edge designs migrate away.
Gross/operating margin suffers persistent impairment beyond explained ramp/overseas-fab effects without a credible recovery path.
Capex stays elevated while utilization/revenue guidance and free cash flow deteriorate, indicating poor incremental capital productivity.
A geopolitical event materially impairs production, logistics, personnel, export capability or market access.

historical_checkpoints.note: Current EV still uses the Q2 average FX analytical convention; P/E is cleaner. Sell-side forecast snapshot remains expectation evidence, not issuer guidance.

forward_expectation_history.key_inference: The principal missed expectation gap was not whether AI existed, but the magnitude and duration of TSMC earnings conversion. FY2026 consensus rose roughly 50% from the last recovered pre-2025-08-19 snapshot to the current review snapshot.

result_attribution.benchmark_method: A separate exact-window benchmark series exists through 2026-08-17; do not infer semiconductor-sector alpha from it without a formal factor model.

upstream_monitor.green: At least two major hyperscalers maintain or raise real AI-infrastructure commitments while cloud/AI demand remains strong, and accelerator/custom-ASIC plus TSM monthly-revenue/guidance evidence remains intact.
upstream_monitor.yellow: Nominal capex remains high but incremental growth is increasingly buildings, leases or component inflation; cloud growth slows or supply constraints ease while TSM evidence remains intact.
upstream_monitor.red: At least two major hyperscalers materially cut real compute plans, combined with deterioration in cloud/AI demand and either TSM three-month revenue/guidance or accelerator/custom-ASIC demand signals.

evidence_summary.source_policy: Primary issuer/SEC and direct IBKR market/account data are load-bearing; third-party sell-side snapshots are used only as market-expectation evidence and remain explicitly classified as forecasts.
unknowns: No verified contemporaneous 2025 TSM buy/add/trim/target/stop/size record was recovered.
Historical EV checkpoints require deterministic quarter-end FX validation before decision-grade promotion.
Ending same-date authoritative FX remains unvalidated for a production-grade ADR/local-share attribution.
Benchmark comparison does not establish semiconductor-sector alpha without a formal factor model.

lessons.principle: Once a security is thesis-ready, missing a scheduled material evidence node without an explicit deprioritization reason is an attention-continuity process failure.
Industry capex guidance can be an upstream evidence node for bottleneck suppliers and should trigger re-underwriting even without a company-specific announcement.
For capital-intensive quality compounders, evaluate capex productivity through utilization, margin, operating cash flow and FCF rather than treating capex magnitude as bullish or bearish by itself.
A missed winner is not automatically an execution failure; distinguish awareness, preparation, priority, monitoring and execution from the contemporaneous record.
Market awareness of a structural theme does not imply the market has correctly priced the magnitude and duration of future earnings revisions.

promotion_requirements: Validate historical balance-sheet-date FX convention and recompute EV checkpoints deterministically.
Validate a same-date authoritative ending FX rate if ADR/local-share attribution is to become production-grade.
Confirm or explicitly accept absence of any 2025 contemporaneous trade-decision record across other broker/account sources if available.
Founder/reviewer explicitly approves current decision, sizing and kill criteria before decision_grade promotion.
